title: Migrate the FastAPI items stub to use an ItemRepository class
description: Migration task on backend_health_endpoint: replace the hard-coded empty list in GET /items with an ItemRepository class that holds items in a dict. GET /items queries the repository. Existing test (returns empty list on fresh start) must still pass.

required_artifacts: src/repository.py with ItemRepository class having list_all, create, get, delete methods
src/app.py imports and uses module-level ItemRepository instance
Original test still passes (empty list on fresh start)
success_criteria: uv run pytest tests/ -v passes (all tests)
uv run python -c "from src.app import app" passes
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to verify the migration is correct. Make sure existing behavior is preserved and the migration handles edge cases safely.
Final verification: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and confirm all tests pass. Is this migration safe to run on real data without data loss or breaking existing clients?

check_commands.build: uv run python -c "from src.app import app"
